description_en: Provides a one-stop AI-powered image processing service for e-commerce sellers. Orchestrates seven atomic capabilities — element detection, intelligent matting, intelligent removal, Image Translation Pro, image expansion, intelligent cropping, and HD upscaling — into an image processing workflow. Upload an image once, select the desired capabilities, and complete multiple image optimizations sequentially in a single call to produce product images that meet listing platform requirements. (Asynchronous)
description_zh: 面向电商卖家的一站式 AI 图片智能处理服务。将元素识别、智能抠图、智能消除、图片翻译 Pro、图像扩展、智能裁剪、高清放大七项原子能力编排为图片处理工作流，用户只需一次上传图片、勾选所需能力，即可按顺序一次性完成多项图片优化，输出符合铺货平台要求的商品图。（异步）
kebab_example: aliyun aidge vision-flow --image-url https://ae01.alicdn.com/kf/S342f0070dc9f4be09a6cbed34e90dc8fs.jpg --ability 1 --object-detect-elements 1 --nonobject-detect-elements 1 --is-filter true --back-ground-type WHITE_BACKGROUND --object-remove-elements 1 --nonobject-remove-elements 1 --mask 474556_160_475356_160 --source-language zh --target-language en --including-product-area false --translating-brand-in-the-product false --glossary glossary_1 --target-width 800 --target-height 800 --upscale-factor 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: VisionFlow

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to process. Required. The resolution must be greater than 256 × 256, the long side must not exceed 1920 pixels, and the short side must not exceed 1080 pixels. The file size must not exceed 5 MB. Supported formats: png, jpeg, jpg, bmp, and webp
parameters.help_zh: 待处理图片URL，必填。分辨率应大于256×256，长边不大于1920像素，短边不大于1080像素；大小不超过5MB；支持png、jpeg、jpg、bmp、webp
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The AI capabilities to apply (1 = intelligent element detection, 2 = intelligent matting, 3 = intelligent removal, 4 = Image Translation Pro, 5 = intelligent cropping, 6 = HD upscaling). Multiple selections allowed
parameters.help_zh: 选择需要处理的AI能力（1=智能元素识别，2=智能抠图，3=智能消除，4=图片翻译Pro，5=智能裁剪，6=高清放大），可多选
parameters.name: ability

parameters.help_en: The elements to detect on the image subject (1 = watermark, 2 = logo, 3 = text, 4 = text-bearing color block). Multiple selections allowed. When the intelligent element detection capability is selected, at least one of ObjectDetectElements and NonobjectDetectElements is required
parameters.help_zh: 检测图片主体上的元素（1=水印；2=Logo；3=文字；4=含字色块），可多选。选择智能元素识别能力时，与NonobjectDetectElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: object_detect_elements

parameters.help_en: The elements to detect on the non-subject area of the image (1 = watermark, 2 = logo, 3 = text, 4 = text-bearing color block). Multiple selections allowed. When the intelligent element detection capability is selected, at least one of NonobjectDetectElements and ObjectDetectElements is required
parameters.help_zh: 检测非图片主体上的元素（1=水印；2=Logo；3=文字；4=含字色块），可多选。选择智能元素识别能力时，与ObjectDetectElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: nonobject_detect_elements

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether images with the detected elements proceed to subsequent processing. A value of true indicates that images containing the elements proceed to subsequent processing. A value of false indicates that they do not. Required when the intelligent element detection capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 选择带有此元素的图片进入后续处理还是不带。true表示带有元素的图片进入后续处理，false表示不带。选择智能元素识别能力时必填
parameters.name: is_filter

parameters.help_en: The background type of the returned image. Valid values: WHITE_BACKGROUND (white background) and TRANSPARENT (transparent background). Required when the intelligent matting capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回的图像背景形式。取值：WHITE_BACKGROUND（白底图）、TRANSPARENT（透明图）。选择智能抠图能力时必填
parameters.name: back_ground_type

parameters.help_en: The elements to remove from the image subject (1 = transparent text block, 2 = specific name, 3 = text, 4 = overlay patch). Multiple selections allowed. When the intelligent removal capability is selected, at least one of ObjectRemoveElements and NonobjectRemoveElements is required
parameters.help_zh: 去除图片主体上的元素（1=透明字块；2=特定名称；3=文字；4=牛皮癣），可多选。选择智能消除能力时，与NonobjectRemoveElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: object_remove_elements

parameters.help_en: The elements to remove from the non-subject area of the image (1 = transparent text block, 2 = specific name, 3 = text, 4 = overlay patch). Multiple selections allowed. When the intelligent removal capability is selected, at least one of NonobjectRemoveElements and ObjectRemoveElements is required
parameters.help_zh: 去除图片非主体上的元素（1=透明字块；2=特定名称；3=文字；4=牛皮癣），可多选。选择智能消除能力时，与ObjectRemoveElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: nonobject_remove_elements

parameters.help_en: The specific removal area in RLE format. Optional. If provided, this parameter takes priority and the ObjectRemoveElements and NonobjectRemoveElements parameters are ignored
parameters.help_zh: 具体的消除区域，RLE格式，选填。若传入将优先使用，忽略ObjectRemoveElements和NonobjectRemoveElements参数
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en: The source language code. Optional. For supported language pairs, see the supported translation language pairs list
parameters.help_zh: 源语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. Optional. For supported language pairs, see the supported translation language pairs list
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate text on the image subject. Optional. Default value: false. Helps protect embedded information such as product names from being translated
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译图片主体上文字，选填，默认false。可帮助保护商品名称等嵌入信息避免被翻译
parameters.name: including_product_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate brand names on the image. Optional. Default value: false. Helps protect brand name information from being translated
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译图片上的品牌名，选填，默认false。可帮助保护品牌名信息避免被翻译
parameters.name: translating_brand_in_the_product

parameters.help_en: The intervention glossary ID. Optional. Create a glossary separately in the console and provide its ID. If left empty, translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表ID，选填。需在前台单独创建并提供其ID。如果为空则翻译结果不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: The desired width of the cropped image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000. Required when the intelligent cropping capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 期望裁剪成的图片宽度，单位像素，取值100-5000。选择智能裁剪能力时必填
parameters.name: target_width

parameters.help_en: The desired height of the cropped image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000. Required when the intelligent cropping capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 期望裁剪成的图片高度，单位像素，取值100-5000。选择智能裁剪能力时必填
parameters.name: target_height

parameters.help_en: The image upscaling factor. Optional. Default value: 2. Valid values: 2 to 4. Required when the HD upscaling capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 图像放大倍数，选填，默认2倍，取值范围2-4。选择高清放大能力时必填
parameters.name: upscale_factor
